topics.materials:

topics.materials:
Curated reference notes (not a claim that the fictional case is real):
1. Potential difference is energy transferred per unit charge; current is charge passing per unit time.

3. In a simple series circuit the current is the same through each component; parallel branches share the potential difference across their common endpoints.
